title: Black & White Wet Look – Monsoon Noir Close-Up
promptText: Transform the uploaded photograph of ONE adult into a photographic black-and-white Monsoon Noir wet-look close-up. Use the uploaded photo as the ONLY facial identity reference: preserve the person's recognizable eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jaw, real skin tone as monochrome luminance, natural skin texture, hairline, hairstyle, facial hair if present, apparent age and proportions, without face replacement or beauty filters. Compose a tightly framed shoulders-up portrait of the subject standing in strong vertical rain against a nearly black background, chin slightly raised and eyes looking toward the camera. Outfit: fully clothed in a dark open-collar button-up shirt, soaked with realistic rainwater, without transparency. Wet strands fall naturally across the forehead, beads of water cling to lashes, cheekbones and collar; individual droplets and fine falling rain remain distinguishable. Use a large soft frontal side light balanced with narrow silver edge illumination, rich near-black shadows, high-detail natural pores and 85mm portrait-lens shallow depth of field. Pure neutral grayscale without sepia or color; 3:4 vertical composition with crop-safe margins, anatomically natural hands if visible; no text, logos, watermark, cloned face, excessive retouching or plastic skin.

title: Black & White Wet Look – Poolside Emergence
promptText: Transform the uploaded photograph of ONE adult into a premium black-and-white wet-look swimmer editorial portrait. Preserve the actual recognizable face, eyes, brows, nose, lips, jawline, hairstyle, hairline, apparent age, body proportions and natural skin texture from the reference photo; grayscale rendering must not change identity or reshape the person. The subject is emerging calmly from a swimming pool, shoulders and upper torso visible above rippling water, wearing a simple opaque black athletic one-piece swimsuit. Hairstyle: naturally slicked-back wet hair with individual damp strands, small visible water droplets across forehead, neck, shoulders and collarbone. Pose: head slightly raised and a quiet determined expression directed to camera, arms relaxed at the pool surface, no glamour exaggeration. Camera just above water level with an 85mm-equivalent focal length and natural compression; medium close-up in a true 3:4 portrait frame. Bright silver reflections on the pool surface contrast with deep charcoal tones; beautiful smooth light falloff with crisp skin detail, realistic waves, splash rings and water physics. Monochrome only, zero colored tint, no text, captions, logos, nudity or watermark.

title: Black & White Wet Look – Factory Rain Wanderer
promptText: Transform the uploaded adult reference photo into a striking monochrome industrial-rain movie-still portrait using the uploaded face as the SOLE identity source. Faithfully preserve facial structure, visible age, natural hairstyle and hair length, facial hair if present, all distinctive features, body proportions and realistic skin texture. Place the person in a disused factory courtyard during steady rain, wearing a fully fastened black leather motorcycle jacket and dark trousers, hands casually tucked in jacket pockets and chin tilted slightly up as they glance off-camera. Behind them show wet cobblestones, fog, high industrial windows, pipe bridges, catwalks, distant smokestack, utility lamps and deep puddle reflections. Damp shoulder-length strands and tiny droplets on leather and eyelashes should feel physically convincing. Frame a three-quarter-length environmental portrait from a 50mm eye-level camera in exact vertical 3:4; render hard side light through the rain balanced with soft atmospheric fill, rich silver-gray highlights, deep cinematic blacks and preserved midtone detail. Black-and-white only, no colored accents, real place logos, text, watermark, face distortion or unnecessary people.

title: Black & White Wet Look – Over-Shoulder Rain Muse
promptText: Convert the uploaded photograph of ONE adult into a high-fashion black-and-white rain editorial centered on the reference person's unmistakable real identity. Preserve the exact recognizable facial anatomy, eyes, brows, lips, nose, jawline, hairstyle, apparent age, skin details and body shape; avoid changing ethnicity, expression or face shape. Pose the fully adult subject in a dark opaque simple sleeveless evening top with one shoulder angled away, then turn the face over the shoulder toward the camera. Long wet hair falls over one cheek and across the back; individual beads of rain catch rim light on the cheek, bare shoulder and strands. Keep the expression composed, subtle and confident. Use an almost-black rain-curtain studio background, crisp dramatic silver edge lighting, soft cheek key-light, high-contrast fine-art monochrome tonal range and shallow depth of field. Render like an authentic editorial photograph at 85mm f/2.8, waist-up, true 3:4 vertical with safe margins; clean anatomy, natural pores, no stylized makeup replacement, no captions, logos or watermark.

title: Black & White Wet Look – Joyful Rain Portrait
promptText: Recreate the adult in the uploaded reference photo as a candid joyful black-and-white portrait caught laughing in refreshing summer rain. The original uploaded photograph is the only identity guide; preserve the subject's recognizable face, eyes, brows, jawline, natural skin features, age, hairstyle, physique and overall proportions, with no face merging or generic model substitution. Set the scene outdoors at night beneath soft falling rain with a very dark uncluttered backdrop. The subject wears an opaque white long-sleeved shirt with a modest neckline over an opaque underlayer, sleeves loosely rolled; rain has dampened the fabric but it must not appear transparent. Capture the person mid-laugh with head slightly tilted up, eyes gently closed, wet shoulder-length hair framing the face and natural water beads on cheek and hair. Use bright silvery backlight to freeze individual raindrops plus soft frontal fill, beautiful deep-gray blacks, rich midtone facial detail and a natural 50mm editorial three-quarter portrait. Pure black-and-white with no warm or blue tint, true 3:4 vertical format, no extra persons, logos, watermark, text or malformed anatomy.
